title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper Verification… (CVE-2026-111513)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have an improper verification of cryptographic signatures vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code and elevate privileges. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-111513 and carries a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.3.
